title: api/swagger: Quote HTTP response status codes
body:
- related to: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53630

go-swagger accepts unquoted response status codes in the Swagger 2.0 definition. OpenAPI 3.x explicitly requires these keys to be quoted for JSON/YAML compatibility, since YAML otherwise parses them as integers.
